I approved the change. Right click on the icon opens a popup with the on/off switch, and left click still toggles. It adds a persisted `Settings` struct next to `enabled` in cosmic_config, with no version bump needed.

`cargo test` builds and passes: 9 passed and 1 ignored (`gamma::live::probe_compositor`). I didn't run the applet, so the popup itself is untested.

The one finding is a suggestion: `Settings::load` and `save_enabled` have no test, and a small test of the default value would be worthwhile.
